findings.heading: Sampling bias / Örnekleme yanlılığı
findings.proposition: The English says increasing sample size will more often than not LEAD TO differences that may be irrelevant after weighting; the Turkish negates the verb ("yol açmamasıdır" = does NOT lead to such differences).
findings.reader_consequence: The Turkish reader gets a reversed and self-contradicting justification for distrusting the binomial p-values, and may conclude that a larger sample cannot produce spurious sample-versus-source differences, so a significant test result will be over-interpreted as real sampling bias.

findings.heading: Demographic pyramids / Demografik piramitler
findings.proposition: The Turkish states that the wrapper function `age_pyramid()` comes from the **sitrep** package; the English states it comes from **apyramid**, which is the package loaded in the setup chunk and the package that actually provides `age_pyramid()`.
findings.reader_consequence: A Turkish reader looking for `age_pyramid()` will search sitrep documentation and may install or attach the wrong package, then get an object-not-found error when running the pyramid chunk.

findings.heading: Demographic pyramids / Demografik piramitler
findings.proposition: The Turkish sends the reader to the help page `?age_pyramid` for details of the `stack_by` argument; the English sends the reader to `?plot_age_pyramid`.
findings.reader_consequence: The Turkish reader opens a different help page than the one documenting the `stack_by = "health_district"` argument, and may not find the argument documentation for stratified pyramids.

findings.heading: Overview / Genel bakış
findings.proposition: The Turkish asserts in the present tense that the GIS basics page already contains a section on spatial random sampling ("bir bölüm mevcuttur"); the English says that page WILL EVENTUALLY have such a section, i.e. it does not have one yet.
findings.reader_consequence: A Turkish reader goes to the GIS basics chapter expecting a spatial random sampling section that does not exist, and wastes time searching for guidance the handbook has not yet written.

findings.heading: Load data / Veri yükleme
findings.proposition: The Turkish claims the benefit of importing the Kobo dictionary with `msf_dict_survey()` is that you get to REUSE YOUR CODE ("kodlarınızı tekrardan kullanma şansınız olur"); the English says the benefit is that the reformatted dictionary can easily be used to RECODE the data values.
findings.reader_consequence: The Turkish reader misses the stated purpose of the reformatted dictionary (recoding the survey variables from short values to labels) and may skip the dictionary import as a mere convenience for code reuse.

findings.heading: Clean data / Veri temizleme
findings.proposition: The Turkish cross-reference for details on `age_categories()` points at the Working with dates chapter (https://epirhandbook.com/working-with-dates.html); the English points at the Cleaning data chapter section on numeric categories (cleaning.qmd#num_cats).
findings.reader_consequence: The Turkish reader who follows the link for age-group creation lands on the dates chapter, which contains nothing about `age_categories()` or numeric categorisation.

findings.heading: Descriptive analysis / Tanımlayıcı analiz
findings.proposition: The Turkish link labelled "ggplot temelleri" (ggplot basics) points at https://epirhandbook.com/tables-for-presentation.html; the English links ggplot basics to ggplot_basics.qmd.
findings.reader_consequence: The Turkish reader following the ggplot basics reference reaches the tables-for-presentation chapter instead, and cannot get to the plotting introduction from here.

findings.heading: Packages / Paketler
findings.proposition: The English links the phrase "R basics" to the R basics chapter (basics.qmd); the Turkish writes "[R temelleri]" with no link target, so no cross-reference to the R basics chapter exists.
findings.reader_consequence: The Turkish reader sees literal bracket text instead of a link and has no route to the R basics chapter for background on R packages.

findings.heading: Weighting / Ağırlıklandırma
findings.proposition: The English links "De-duplication" to the de-duplication chapter (deduplication.qmd); the Turkish writes "[Tekilleştirme]" with no link target, so no cross-reference to that chapter exists.
findings.reader_consequence: The Turkish reader is told to see the de-duplication chapter for details on removing duplicates but has no link to reach it, and may skip duplicate removal before weighting.
